intro.title: Scenario II: New Horizons
intro.body: With Detective Reynolds at your side, you head to the New Horizons facility in the Waterfront District. “Well, the way I see it we’ve got two options,” Reynolds says. “We can go in now and conduct our search. I’ve got the warrant, and it’ll be more official, but there’s also people who are working. People complicate things. Or…” He produces a set of lockpicks. “We wait until after dark.”
intro.addCultist: Add 1 {'{'}cultist{'}'} token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
intro.chooseAsGroup: The investigators must choose, as a group:
intro.searchDuringTheDay: Search during the day (Hint: Prepare to talk your way in). Proceed to _Setup (v. I)_.
intro.searchAfterDark: Search after dark (Hint: Prepare to fight your way in). Skip to _Setup (v. II)_.

setup.title: Setup (v. I)
setup.gatherSets:

Flying Terrors{'{'}asterisk{'}'}

setup.gatherLocations: Gather each location in the _New Horizons_ encounter set.
setup.day: Put each _Day_ location into play. Remove each _Night_ location from the game. Each investigator begins play at a Factory Floor location of their choice.
setup.shallowTunnels: If you are playing on Easy or Standard difficulty, set Cavern Entrance (*Shallow Tunnels*), Descending Tunnel, and all 3 copies of Side Chamber (*Shallow Tunnels*) aside, out of play. Remove each remaining location from the game.
setup.darkestDepths: If you are playing on Hard or Expert difficulty, set Cavern Entrance (*Darkest Depths*), Descending Tunnel, and all 3 copies of Side Chamber (*Darkest Depths*) aside, out of play. Remove each remaining location from the game.
setup.agendaDeck: Construct the agenda deck using agenda 1a—“Busy Day” and agenda 2a—“Digging Deeper (v. I).” Remove each other agenda from the game.
setup.factoryWorkers: Spawn 1 Factory Worker enemy at each Factory Floor location.
setup.zburamoarte: Gather each copy of the Zburamoarte enemy.
setup.lethargicBeast: If you are playing on Easy difficulty, set Zburamoarte (*Lethargic Beast*) aside, out of play. Remove each other copy of Zburamoarte from the game.
setup.sourceOfTheBlight: If you are playing on Standard difficulty, set Zburamoarte (*Source of the Blight*) aside, out of play. Remove each other copy of Zburamoarte from the game.
setup.progenitorOfMonsters: If you are playing on Hard or Expert difficulty, set Zburamoarte (*Progenitor of Monsters*) aside, out of play. Remove each other copy of Zburamoarte from the game.
setup.setAside: Set the following cards aside, out of play: the Javier Rivera enemy, each copy of the Blighted Worker enemy, each copy of the Echoing in Darkness treachery, the _Infected_ and _Flying Terrors_ encounter sets, and the Forged Permit and Sanguine Song story assets.
setup.removeNightWatchman: Remove the Night Watchman enemy from the game.
